item.title: Small Texas law firm set to receive $150M to represent unaccompanied migrant children
item.description: The firm, Houston-based Burke Law Group has only two attorneys who specialize in immigration and asylum cases. Two of its founders have ties to the Trump administration.

item.title: New Mexico is investigating Epstein's activities within state lines
item.description: The New Mexico attorney general is suing the U.S. Department of Justice for more information about Jeffrey Epstein and his activities at a ranch near Santa Fe.

item.title: Kyiv residents face attacks with fewer defenses overhead
item.description: Another overnight attack killed at least 17 people in and around Kyiv. The strikes come as Ukraine faces a growing shortage of the interceptor missiles used to defend the capital.

item.title: How one negative google review led to the New Bedford Whaling museum to go viral
item.description: After a a Google user left a one-star review of the New Bedford Whaling Museum, calling it the "worst Aquarium Ever" the museum created merch with the phrase on it that has gone viral.

item.title: The local impact of changing federal grant rules
item.description: Democratic policy makers are pushing back on a rule change proposed by the Office of Management and Budget that would grant political appointees veto power over federal research grants. We talk with people at the level of local government about what this could mean for them in areas like public health and research.

item.title: Myanmar's conflict tops 100,000 dead as junta benefits from world's inattention
item.description: A 2021 military coup plunged Myanmar into a brutal civil war, ousting Aung San Suu Kyi's elected government. For years, the world isolated the junta. That isolation is breaking down.
